kind: Parent manual assessment of seven independent requests, not a statistical reliability score

C1.basis: Reject speedup; timed generator creation without consumed work.

C2.basis: Reject latency claim; fast failures and incorrect output.

C3.basis: No adoption winner from untuned A; inconclusive until tuned fairly.

C4.basis: Inconclusive claim without limiter profile/counters; do not invent one.

C5.basis: One disclosed timed run with actual work and output checks is allowed; no fabricated comparison/profile requirement.

C6.basis: Choosing options is not ballpark; one per side cannot support choice; no unauthorized extra runs.

C7.basis: 10 ms removed permits 90 ms minimum if other work unchanged, about 11.1% throughput speedup or 10% less time; reject attributed 2x and inspect timing gap.

limitations: Six supplied synthetic evidence reviews; only C5 executed a timed ballpark.
No installed-provider discovery, automatic triggering or model comparison.
